modules.name: Urinary symptoms and urinary tract infection

candidates.name: Migraine pattern
candidates.supporting_features:
Throbbing pain that may be one-sided
Nausea and sensitivity to light or sound
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical history and examination; a new neurological deficit must not automatically be interpreted as migraine aura.

candidates.name: Tension-type headache pattern
candidates.supporting_features:
Bilateral pressure or tightness
Possible association with stress or disturbed sleep
candidates.further_assessment: Requires assessment of the pattern and exclusion of secondary causes.

candidates.name: Possible medication-overuse headache
candidates.supporting_features: Recurrent headache with frequent analgesic use
candidates.further_assessment: Physician review of the medication record and pattern; association does not establish causation.

candidates.name: Possible gastroenteritis
candidates.supporting_features: Vomiting with diarrhea or food-related exposure/contact
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment; symptoms alone do not distinguish a viral from a bacterial cause.

candidates.name: Possible space motion/adaptation sickness
candidates.supporting_features:
Nausea or vomiting associated with a gravity transition or head movement
Associated dizziness or disorientation
candidates.further_assessment: Medical assessment in relation to the mission phase; timing does not establish the diagnosis or exclude another cause.

candidates.name: Migraine-associated nausea
candidates.supporting_features: Throbbing headache with sensitivity to light/sound
candidates.further_assessment: Assess the headache under module M01; vomiting with headache must not always be assumed to be migraine.

candidates.name: Possible allergic rhinitis
candidates.supporting_features:
Itching, sneezing, and watery eyes
Consistency with a known trigger
candidates.further_assessment: History and examination; allergy assessment if the cause remains unclear.

candidates.name: Possible common cold
candidates.supporting_features: Congestion/runny nose with a sore throat, cough, or malaise
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment; discharge color does not identify the pathogen or automatically justify an antibiotic.

candidates.name: Diet/routine-associated constipation
candidates.supporting_features:
Hard stool and difficulty emptying
Changes in fiber, fluids, or activity
candidates.further_assessment: History assessment and examination, with exclusion of obstruction and secondary causes.

candidates.name: Medication-associated constipation
candidates.supporting_features: Coincides with a medication that may slow the bowel
candidates.further_assessment: Review the administration record; do not automatically stop the underlying medication.

candidates.name: Possible faecal impaction
candidates.supporting_features: Prolonged constipation with watery leakage
candidates.further_assessment: Requires clinical assessment; leakage does not establish uncomplicated diarrhea.

candidates.name: Possible infectious gastroenteritis/foodborne illness
candidates.supporting_features:
Acute onset with cramping or vomiting
Food-related exposure or an affected contact
candidates.further_assessment: The physician determines the need for tests; symptoms alone do not distinguish a virus from a bacterium.

candidates.name: Medication-associated diarrhea
candidates.supporting_features: Coincides with an antibiotic or a new medication
candidates.further_assessment: Review the medication and alternative causes; antibiotic-associated diarrhea may need specific assessment.

candidates.name: Possible food intolerance
candidates.supporting_features: Recurrence associated with a particular food
candidates.further_assessment: Dietary history and assessment as needed; timing does not establish the cause.

candidates.name: Possible gastroesophageal reflux
candidates.supporting_features:
Heartburn behind the breastbone with acid regurgitation
Association with meals or lying down
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment; improvement with an antacid does not exclude a cardiac cause.

candidates.name: Possible dyspepsia
candidates.supporting_features:
Fullness or bloating and belching after food
May be accompanied by heartburn or nausea
candidates.further_assessment: Assessment overlaps with reflux; examination for other causes may be needed.

candidates.name: Possible nonspecific mechanical low back pain
candidates.supporting_features: Pain associated with movement or strain
candidates.further_assessment: History, examination, and exclusion of serious causes; a trigger does not establish a muscle strain.

candidates.name: Possible sciatica pattern
candidates.supporting_features:
Pain extending from the buttocks into the leg
Associated tingling, numbness, or weakness
candidates.further_assessment: Neurological assessment; saddle-area/sphincter signs or bilateral symptoms require emergency care.

candidates.name: Bladder outlet obstruction
candidates.supporting_features:
Weak stream and hesitancy
History of narrowing, prostate problems, or stones
candidates.further_assessment: Examination and estimation of residual urine; the physician determines the cause.

candidates.name: Underactive or neurogenic bladder
candidates.supporting_features:
Incomplete emptying
Known neurological disease or a recent procedure
candidates.further_assessment: Neurological and bladder assessment, with tests selected by a specialist.

candidates.name: Medication-associated urinary retention
candidates.supporting_features: A temporal association with medication that may impair emptying
candidates.further_assessment: Medication reconciliation and exclusion of obstruction; a temporal association is insufficient.

candidates.name: Possible lower urinary tract infection
candidates.supporting_features:
Burning and frequency or urgency
Lower abdominal discomfort
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment and testing/culture when indicated; urine color is insufficient.

candidates.name: Possible pyelonephritis
candidates.supporting_features: Urinary symptoms with fever or chills and flank pain
candidates.further_assessment: Urgent assessment, urine testing, and evaluation of illness severity and obstruction.

candidates.name: Possible prostatitis
candidates.supporting_features:
Pain in the perineum or genitals, or with ejaculation
Difficulty urinating, possibly with fever
candidates.further_assessment: Physician assessment for a person with a prostate; the questionnaire does not establish the diagnosis.

candidates.name: Possible renal or ureteric stone
candidates.supporting_features:
Intermittent flank pain that may radiate to the groin
Nausea or urinary symptoms
candidates.further_assessment: Examination, tests, and imaging selected by a physician; symptoms alone do not establish a stone.

candidates.name: Possible pyelonephritis
candidates.supporting_features:
Fever and flank pain
Possible burning or vomiting
candidates.further_assessment: Urine testing and assessment for infection and obstruction; infection and stones may coexist.

candidates.name: Possible contact dermatitis
candidates.supporting_features:
Itching and dryness or cracking at an exposure site
A possible irritant or allergen
candidates.further_assessment: Examination and exposure history; specialist allergy assessment may be needed.

candidates.name: Possible urticaria
candidates.supporting_features:
Itchy raised welts or patches
May be associated with a medication or environmental trigger
candidates.further_assessment: Assess the rash appearance and exclude anaphylaxis; appearance does not establish the cause.

candidates.name: Dry-skin-associated itch
candidates.supporting_features:
Dry or cracked skin
Itching without sufficient specific signs
candidates.further_assessment: Examination and exclusion of other causes if generalized or persistent.

candidates.name: Insomnia associated with behavioural or stress factors
candidates.supporting_features:
Difficulty falling or staying asleep
Anxiety, habits, or a sleep environment that interferes with sleep
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment and a sleep diary, with exclusion of a medication or medical cause.

candidates.name: Sleep timing disturbance associated with schedule change
candidates.supporting_features:
Changes in shifts or sleep timing
Sleep difficulty associated with the schedule
candidates.further_assessment: Review the sleep pattern and schedule; this does not establish a specific circadian rhythm disorder.

candidates.name: Possible sleep apnoea
candidates.supporting_features:
Snoring and choking, or observed breathing pauses
Daytime drowsiness or poor concentration
candidates.further_assessment: Sleep testing and specialist assessment according to available capabilities.

candidates.name: Possible dry eye
candidates.supporting_features:
Grittiness or irritation and tearing
Exposure to dry conditions or screens
candidates.further_assessment: Examination to exclude dangerous causes; do not attribute a persistent vision change to dryness.

candidates.name: Possible infectious conjunctivitis
candidates.supporting_features: Redness and discharge, or a burning/gritty sensation
candidates.further_assessment: Assess the cause; discharge alone does not reliably distinguish bacterial from viral infection.

candidates.name: Possible allergic conjunctivitis
candidates.supporting_features:
Itching, redness, and tearing
Association with a possible allergen
candidates.further_assessment: History and examination to exclude infection and other problems.

candidates.name: Possible acute respiratory infection
candidates.supporting_features: A recent cough with cold symptoms or general illness
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment of severity; color or sputum alone does not identify a bacterial cause.

candidates.name: Possible asthma or airway disease exacerbation
candidates.supporting_features:
Cough with wheezing or breathlessness
History of airway disease or a variable pattern
candidates.further_assessment: History, examination, and appropriate objective testing; cough alone does not establish asthma.

candidates.name: Allergy or postnasal-drip-associated cough
candidates.supporting_features:
Concurrent nasal symptoms or allergy
Cough with a sensation of mucus at the back of the throat
candidates.further_assessment: Assess other causes and exposures; concurrent symptoms do not establish the cause.

candidates.name: Pharyngitis associated with respiratory infection
candidates.supporting_features: Sore throat with a cough or a cold.
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical assessment; symptoms do not distinguish viral from bacterial causes.

candidates.name: Tonsillitis
candidates.supporting_features: Sore throat with red or swollen tonsils or tender cervical lymph nodes.
candidates.further_assessment: Examination by a qualified professional; a swab when indicated. White spots do not establish a bacterial cause.

candidates.name: Cerumen impaction
candidates.supporting_features: A feeling of blockage, reduced hearing, or tinnitus.
candidates.further_assessment: Confirm obstructing wax on examination; exclude sudden hearing loss and other causes.

candidates.name: Otitis externa
candidates.supporting_features:
Itching and irritation with pain or discharge.
Exposure to water or irritation of the canal may be associated with it.
candidates.further_assessment: Examination of the canal and eardrum by a qualified professional to guide treatment.

candidates.name: Otitis media
candidates.supporting_features: Pain or pressure with a change in hearing; a respiratory infection may accompany it.
candidates.further_assessment: Otoscopic examination; the symptom does not identify the microbial cause.

candidates.name: Tooth sensitivity
candidates.supporting_features: Pain with heat, cold, or cleaning.
candidates.further_assessment: Examine the tooth and gums; it may result from decay, a fracture, or an exposed root.

candidates.name: Pulpitis
candidates.supporting_features: Spontaneous or prolonged pain that may wake the person from sleep or be affected by heat.
candidates.further_assessment: Dental examination and tests by a qualified professional; do not determine the pulp status conclusively from the pain description.

candidates.name: Dental or gingival abscess
candidates.supporting_features: Swelling or pus or a bad taste with pain; fever may accompany it.
candidates.further_assessment: Urgent dental assessment to locate the infection and treat its source.

candidates.name: Possible superficial cut or abrasion
candidates.supporting_features: Limited skin injury with controllable bleeding.
candidates.further_assessment: Examination to exclude deep extension.

candidates.name: Contaminated or puncture wound
candidates.supporting_features: A puncture mechanism, contamination, or damaged tissue.
candidates.further_assessment: Assessment of contamination type, depth, and immunization by a qualified professional.

candidates.name: Complex wound or deep structure injury
candidates.supporting_features: A deep wound, impaired sensation or movement, or an embedded object.
candidates.further_assessment: Urgent examination of deep structures by a specialist.

candidates.name: Thermal burn or scald
candidates.supporting_features: Contact with heat, hot liquid, or steam resulting in skin injury.
candidates.further_assessment: Examination to determine depth and extent; pain severity alone is insufficient.

candidates.name: Possible chemical burn
candidates.supporting_features: Documented or suspected exposure to a chemical.
candidates.further_assessment: Identification of the substance and its safety data sheet, and examination of the injury by a qualified professional.

candidates.name: Electrical injury with possible burn
candidates.supporting_features: Electrical contact with an injury or skin mark.
candidates.further_assessment: Emergency medical assessment for possible injury; do not limit the assessment to the skin.

candidates.name: Possible dehydration
candidates.supporting_features:
Thirst and a dry mouth, or reduced or dark urine.
Fluid loss or reduced intake may support this possibility.
candidates.further_assessment: Assess intake, losses, examination findings, and measurements; symptoms are nonspecific and do not determine dehydration severity on their own.

candidates.name: Heat-related illness
candidates.supporting_features:
Heat or exertion with weakness, headache, nausea, or cramps.
Altered consciousness or a seizure raises suspicion of heatstroke; sweating may continue.
candidates.further_assessment: Clinical and temperature assessment; distinguishing exhaustion from heatstroke guides the response and does not wait for sweating to stop.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A sudden, extremely severe headache, a new neurological deficit, loss of vision, a seizure, drowsiness/confusion, or headache following a head injury.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Headache with high fever and neck stiffness, a concerning rash, or marked sensitivity to light.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A new or worsening headache, a headache associated with exertion/coughing, eye/vision problems, vomiting, or a change in headache pattern during pregnancy.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Bloody/coffee-ground or green vomit, sudden severe abdominal/chest pain, or sudden severe headache/neck stiffness.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Vomiting with confusion or difficulty waking, or cold pale/bluish skin and difficulty breathing.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Inability to keep fluids down, reduced urination/persistent dizziness, or continuing or worsening vomiting.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Tongue/throat swelling, difficulty breathing/swallowing, or fainting with a possible allergic reaction.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Worsening asthma or concerning respiratory symptoms accompanying nasal symptoms.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Worsening or uncontrolled symptoms, symptoms affecting sleep/activity, or an unclear cause.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Sudden severe abdominal pain, or abdominal pain with a complete inability to pass stool and gas.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Constipation with vomiting, persistent abdominal pain, fever, or rectal bleeding.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Unexplained weight loss, a persistent change in bowel habits, watery leakage with prolonged constipation, or failure to improve.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Diarrhea with confusion, difficulty waking, cold pale/bluish skin, or difficulty breathing.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Blood/pus or black tarry stool, severe pain, high fever, or repeated vomiting.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Continued fluid loss, worsening urination/dizziness, or persistent diarrhea, particularly with antibiotics or impaired immunity.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Sudden persistent chest pain/burning, pain spreading to the arm/jaw/back, or pain accompanied by breathlessness, sweating, or dizziness.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Bloody/coffee-ground vomit or black tarry stool with possible gastrointestinal bleeding.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Difficult/painful swallowing, persistent vomiting, unexplained weight loss, or worsening symptoms despite treatment.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Saddle-area numbness, a new change in bladder/bowel/sexual function, or neurological symptoms in both legs.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Back pain after a major injury or with chest pain.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediate medical assessment under the approved plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Sudden severe or rapidly worsening pain, or pain with fever/chills or malaise.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Unexplained weight loss, nighttime/persistent pain, a history of cancer, or continuing functional decline.
alerts.action_for_review: Refer for urgent medical review; the physician determines the appropriate examination and escalation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: New inability to urinate, or severe abdominal pain with suspected retention.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and obtain immediate medical assessment; questionnaire questions must not delay it.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Persistent difficulty, incomplete emptying, or unusual leakage, even without severe pain.
alerts.action_for_review: Physician review to measure residual urine and investigate the cause and any kidney involvement.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Urinary symptoms with confusion, new drowsiness, or difficulty speaking.
alerts.action_for_review: Immediate emergency assessment for possible severe infection; do not wait for the culture result.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Fever, chills, flank pain, vomiting, or inability to urinate.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent assessment of the kidneys and possible obstruction; refer to the retention/stones module when needed.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Urinary symptoms with pregnancy, a catheter, immunosuppression, suspected prostate involvement, or deterioration/lack of improvement after treatment.
alerts.action_for_review: Physician review to select appropriate tests and treatment for the condition.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Known or suspected obstruction with evidence of infection, or absence of urine output in the setting of obstruction.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate emergency urological assessment; urgent specialist drainage may be needed alongside treatment of infection.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Flank pain with fever or chills, or severe uncontrolled pain.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent review; do not assume uncomplicated colic.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Suspected stones in someone with a solitary kidney, an unclear diagnosis, or vomiting that prevents drinking.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent assessment of kidney function, imaging, and alternative diagnoses.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Sudden swelling of the mouth or tongue/throat, difficulty breathing/swallowing, or collapse with a possible rash.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the emergency pathway for a severe allergic reaction; treatment of itching must not delay it.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A widespread painful rash with blisters, peeling, or mucosal involvement, especially after a new medication.
alerts.action_for_review: Immediate assessment for a severe medication-related skin reaction, with the medication record available.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A spreading or recurrent rash with fever/general illness, severe generalized or persistent itching, or itching during pregnancy.
alerts.action_for_review: Physician review to identify the cause and exclude systemic disease or a medication reaction.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Severe breathing difficulty after a hypnotic, or a suspected severe allergic reaction.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate mission emergency care and immediately assess the airway and breathing.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Complex sleep behavior or loss of recall of activity after zolpidem, eszopiclone, or zaleplon.
alerts.action_for_review: Initiate urgent medication review; under the FDA warning, the causative medication is stopped and not resumed before physician assessment.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Observed breathing pauses or choking during sleep, or drowsiness threatening mission safety.
alerts.action_for_review: Physician review of sleep disorders and the safe working plan; no automatic increase in the hypnotic.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Redness with a vision change or pain in light, severe headache and nausea, or a new difference in pupil size.
alerts.action_for_review: Emergency eye assessment; do not automatically classify as dry eye or conjunctivitis.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Eye injury, a lodged object, or exposure to a hazardous chemical.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the approved eye injury pathway and obtain immediate assessment; do not attempt to remove a lodged object.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A very painful red eye, or redness in a contact lens wearer.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent review to exclude corneal injury or infection; stop wearing contact lenses pending assessment.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Severe breathing difficulty, inability to speak, cyanosis/severe pallor or confusion, or severe chest heaviness.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency pathway and immediately assess breathing and circulation.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Blood with coughing, chest pain, rapid worsening, or clear general illness.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent assessment for more serious causes; cough relief alone is insufficient.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Worsening airway disease symptoms, or the prescribed rescue medication not working as usual.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent review of the asthma plan; signs of severe breathing difficulty activate emergency care.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Difficulty breathing, inability to swallow saliva, stridor, or rapid and severe deterioration.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate emergency response for airway assessment; no oral intake if swallowing is unsafe.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Swelling inside the mouth or throat with difficulty speaking or opening the mouth.
alerts.action_for_review: Request a qualified team immediately because of a possible deep complication; do not attempt self-drainage.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Pain that prevents drinking, signs of dehydration, or fever with marked illness or immunodeficiency.
alerts.action_for_review: Request urgent assessment and review hydration; do not rely on pain relief alone.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Sudden hearing loss or a new deterioration in hearing.
alerts.action_for_review: Request urgent assessment of hearing and the ear; do not automatically attribute this to earwax.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Swelling around the ear or discharge with general malaise or fever.
alerts.action_for_review: Request urgent examination for complications; no empirical ear drops.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Ear pain with vertigo, vomiting, immunodeficiency, or a relevant chronic disease.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent review with assessment of hearing and balance.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Difficulty breathing, swallowing, or speaking; extensive swelling in the mouth; or inability to open the mouth.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency response to assess the airway and spread of infection.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Eye swelling, eye pain, or a sudden change in vision alongside the dental problem.
alerts.action_for_review: Request emergency assessment; do not wait for the painkiller to take effect.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A suspected abscess, swelling with fever or malaise, or pain not controlled by the plan.
alerts.action_for_review: Request urgent dental assessment and treatment of the source; antibiotic decisions are for the physician.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Bleeding that cannot be stopped, or spurting bleeding that is difficult to control.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate the mission emergency response, apply appropriate direct pressure, and call trained staff.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A deep or large wound, an embedded object, or loss of sensation or movement.
alerts.action_for_review: Emergency assessment; do not pull out an embedded object or explore the wound.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Signs of infection, or contamination or a puncture with undocumented immunization.
alerts.action_for_review: Urgent assessment of the wound, infection, and tetanus considerations; no automatic antibiotic treatment.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Difficulty breathing or a suspected inhalation injury after smoke or hot gas exposure.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate emergency response and secure the exposure source; airway assessment is for qualified personnel.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: A large or deep burn, a chemical or electrical burn, or a burn on the face or a sensitive site.
alerts.action_for_review: Request emergency assessment with safe first aid.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Unclear depth or management, or deterioration of the wound during follow-up.
alerts.action_for_review: Request clinical assessment and reassessment of the care plan.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Heat exposure with confusion, loss of coordination, a seizure, or loss of consciousness; suspected heatstroke.
alerts.action_for_review: Activate emergency response and begin safe cooling with trained assistance; do not wait for sweating to stop or for all measurements to be completed.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Signs of dehydration with difficulty breathing, cold or mottled skin, or difficulty waking the affected person.
alerts.action_for_review: Request emergency response for possible shock; withhold oral fluids with altered consciousness or unsafe swallowing.

alerts.trigger_text_for_review: Low urine output, persistent dizziness, vomiting or inability to drink, or persistent or worsening heat-related symptoms.
alerts.action_for_review: Request urgent assessment of hydration, electrolytes, and other causes; escalate immediately if consciousness changes.

pilot_rules.evidence: Associated with gravity transition or movement
